reviews.title: Nice looking, performs up to expected specs
reviews.comment:
A really nice looking motherboard, and performs up to spec.  I have two M.2 drives on it (though they are Gen4, rather than the Gen5 supported by the slot closest to the CPU).  The system meets the expected benchmarks.

I like having the 2 digit LED POST display, and stepped up into this tier of mobo to get that.

It looks really nice in my white Corsair case.

Setting up the memory to go from the default 4800 MT/s to 6400 MT/s was very easy - can even do that without resorting to the advanced configuration tab.
